set.body:
Private cross-implementation validation found density-score differences explained by declared estimator conventions. Source-side cell binning dominates the staged decomposition of the largest original behavioral and Signy discrepancies; smaller terms come from finite Gaussian support, evaluation-grid placement and reference rounding. Independent direct-sum oracles reproduce each estimator. This is not evidence that either native estimator is automatically the correct scientific choice.

Relevant seams at eyes4s bbb9d49a: surface/Smoother.scala bins PointMeasure before separable convolution and uses a ceil(3*sigma/cell) radius. Pinned eyesim 36a96f962263a78de20dac010a8ec556e473e4fd uses R/similarity.R; the validation harness explicitly selects ks binned=FALSE and supp=3.7, and eye_density rounds normalized values with zapsmall(digits=7). Harness choices must not be described as universal eyesim defaults.

Acceptance: add independently authored synthetic density cases and a resolution/sigma convergence study with fixed points, weights, crop, query/template identities and control pool. Separate binning, support, grid placement and rounding with named score/map tolerances. Report signed corrected-score changes and zero crossings, not only correlation. State when a convention is an intentional approximation and when a common estimator is required for parity. Preserve native outputs; do not widen tolerances or alter private original receipts. Use per-ticket R parity fixtures and keep private rows, source files and images out of the public repository.

The private discrepancy register is fixtures/private/discrepancy-tracking/20261013/REPORT.md. Ordered staged decompositions explain their selected cases; they are not an order-independent attribution or proof that every query has the same dominant term.
set.title: Density parity: quantify grid-resolution sensitivity and name estimator conventions
